AssuranceType.description: Closed enum, required `assurance_type` attribute on `assures` edges.

DecisionSubtype.description: Closed enum, attribute on /decision fragments (no path slot).

EvidenceSubtype.description: Closed enum, prefix of slot 3 of /evidence/{iso2}/{subtype}-{slug}.

InfluenceKind.description: Closed enum, required `influence_kind` attribute on `influences` edges.

attribute_spec.name: schema_version
attribute_spec.description: Stamped by migrate-cli (and on every write going forward) to track which canonical-control-plane revision produced the document. Format: '<major>.<minor>', e.g. '2.0'.

attribute_spec.name: coordinates
attribute_spec.description: Lat/lng pair: {'lat': float, 'lng': float}. For /route this is a representative point; full polyline lives in `geometry`.

attribute_spec.name: geometry
attribute_spec.description: GeoJSON-like polyline / polygon for routes (corridor curve), regions (boundary), and large sites (footprint).

attribute_spec.name: geo_slug
attribute_spec.description: Denormalized iso2 / region slug from the canonical path's geo segment, cached for fast filtering on the FE.

attribute_spec.name: geo_feature_type
attribute_spec.description: GeoNames feature class (P=populated place, S=spot/structure, T=mountain, etc.) when known.

attribute_spec.name: radius_km
attribute_spec.description: Effective radius in kilometers for circular zone rendering on the map.

attribute_spec.name: lifecycle_stage
attribute_spec.description: Free-form lifecycle marker (e.g. 'planned', 'operational', 'decommissioned', 'pending', 'expired'). Decision lifecycle uses the more specific `status` attribute.

attribute_spec.name: market_segments
attribute_spec.description: List of market-segment slugs the fragment participates in.

attribute_spec.name: industry_paths
attribute_spec.description: Canonical industry-taxonomy paths (e.g. /industry/chemicals/specialty).

attribute_spec.name: sphere_paths
attribute_spec.description: Canonical sphere paths (L1/L2/L3 fractal taxonomy slugs). Replaces the now-folded /sphere/* fragments.

attribute_spec.name: domain_slug
attribute_spec.description: Domain slug lifted from the now-folded /domain/* fragments; identifies which strategic domain a decision/mechanism belongs to.

attribute_spec.name: discovered_in_domain
attribute_spec.description: Provenance attribute: which /domain/* fragment first surfaced this decision/mechanism. Lifted from the legacy SURFACES edge.

attribute_spec.name: identifiers
attribute_spec.description: Map of external IDs: lei, isin, imo, mmso, wikidata_qid, gleif_id, etc.

attribute_spec.name: name_history
attribute_spec.description: Historical names with valid_from/valid_to ranges.

attribute_spec.name: alternative_names
attribute_spec.description: Known aliases / surface-form variants beyond the primary `surface_forms` list.

attribute_spec.name: org_size
attribute_spec.description: Coarse org size bucket (micro / small / mid / large / mega).

attribute_spec.name: gov_type
attribute_spec.description: For org.gov subtype: ministry / agency / regulator / soe / parliament / court / etc.

attribute_spec.name: parent_path
attribute_spec.description: Canonical path of the parent fragment (org parent, site operator, product family parent, geo container).

attribute_spec.name: community_subtype
attribute_spec.description: Closed enum (see COMMUNITY_SUBTYPES).

attribute_spec.name: mode
attribute_spec.description: Transport mode of the corridor: sea / rail / pipeline / road / multimodal / air.

attribute_spec.name: length_km
attribute_spec.description: Approximate corridor length in kilometers.

attribute_spec.name: vessel_class_refs
attribute_spec.description: List of /vessel_class/* canonical paths the corridor supports.

attribute_spec.name: status
attribute_spec.description: Decision lifecycle state: pending / decided / expired / withdrawn / superseded.

attribute_spec.name: deadline
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 deadline / expected-decision date.

attribute_spec.name: outcome
attribute_spec.description: Free-form description of the decided outcome (populated when status=decided).

attribute_spec.name: product_fragment_id
attribute_spec.description: Required fragment id of the /product cargo being supplied. Validated by validate_graph.

attribute_spec.name: kind
attribute_spec.description: Endpoint-projection kind label stamped from RELATION_ENDPOINT_KINDS at edge build time. Universal across recognized relations.

attribute_spec.name: route_fragment_id
attribute_spec.description: Reference to the /route corridor this leg traverses; the route holds the geometry and mode.

attribute_spec.name: vessel_class_fragment_id
attribute_spec.description: Reference to the /vessel_class used on the leg / charter.

attribute_spec.name: route_overlay_key
attribute_spec.description: Stable key grouping multiple supplies projections onto the same physical corridor for map overlay rendering.

attribute_spec.name: incoterm
attribute_spec.description: Optional ICC Incoterms 2020 code (closed enum INCOTERMS_2020). Validated by validate_graph.

attribute_spec.name: gated_by_decision_fragment_id
attribute_spec.description: Hard gating: if the referenced /decision goes against the actor, this flow is blocked (e.g. denied license, sanctions designation).

attribute_spec.name: influenced_by_decision_fragment_id
attribute_spec.description: Soft shaping: the referenced /decision changes the cost/terms/timing of this flow without blocking it (compliance overhead, reinterpreted requirements, etc.).

attribute_spec.name: influence_kind
attribute_spec.description: Required closed enum (see INFLUENCE_KINDS / normalize_influence_kind). Disambiguates the channel through which informal power is exerted.

attribute_spec.name: evidence_refs
attribute_spec.description: Optional list of evidence-archive source ids supporting the relation (kept on the edge for fast UI hover-cards; canonical claim refs live in source_claim_ids).

attribute_spec.name: assurance_type
attribute_spec.description: Required closed enum (see ASSURANCE_TYPES / normalize_assurance_type). Distinguishes audit / certification / regulatory_inspection / attestation.

attribute_spec.name: period_start
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 start of the assurance period.

attribute_spec.name: period_end
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 end of the assurance period.

attribute_spec.name: report_url
attribute_spec.description: URL of the published assurance report (when public).

attribute_spec.name: mobile_asset_kind
attribute_spec.description: Closed enum (see MOBILE_ASSET_KINDS / normalize_mobile_asset_kind). Distinguishes vessel / aircraft / locomotive / rig / satellite / vehicle / asset.

attribute_spec.name: vessel_class_path
attribute_spec.description: Canonical /vessel_class/* path describing this individual asset's class (LR2, VLCC, A380, etc.).

attribute_spec.name: operator_org_path
attribute_spec.description: Canonical path of the org currently operating the asset (operator/charterer/airline/carrier).

attribute_spec.name: owner_org_path
attribute_spec.description: Canonical path of the org that owns the asset (often differs from operator).

attribute_spec.name: flag_geo_path
attribute_spec.description: Canonical /geo/* path of the flag-of-registration jurisdiction (vessels) or registration country (aircraft).

attribute_spec.name: last_known_position
attribute_spec.description: Most recent reported lat/lng of the mobile asset (AIS / ADS-B / proprietary tracker).

attribute_spec.name: last_position_observed_at
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last reported position.

attribute_spec.name: membership_role
attribute_spec.description: Free-form role of the member within the body (chair / member / observer / treasurer / etc.). Intentionally not a closed enum yet — domain too broad.

attribute_spec.name: membership_status
attribute_spec.description: Lifecycle of the membership: active / suspended / former / pending. Drives historical filters in FE.

attribute_spec.name: joined_at
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 date the membership began.

attribute_spec.name: left_at
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 date the membership ended (only set when membership_status != active).

attribute_spec.name: disruption_kind
attribute_spec.description: Required closed enum (see DISRUPTION_KINDS / normalize_disruption_kind). Names the qualitative nature of the disruption.

attribute_spec.name: severity
attribute_spec.description: Coarse severity bucket: low / medium / high / critical. Used by FE for color-coding affected-asset overlays.

attribute_spec.name: valid_from
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 start of the time-bound effect (if any). Universal time-bound qualifier; declared once with multi-relation applies_to so codegen emits a single helper.

attribute_spec.name: valid_to
attribute_spec.description: ISO 8601 end of the time-bound effect (if any).
